_doc: Hand-authored gold back-reference pairs for the real-onyx held-out cosine discrimination ship test (Task #120). Non-circular: a human picked the target turn each query refers back to (NOT cosine). query/target are USER-turn indices (0-based) into the session's user-turn list (the conversation-slot units the ring holds at serve, orchestrator.py:642). age = query - target - 1; valid in-window pairs have age in [age_threshold=3, window-1=15]. Sessions held out of the doc-ring trace generator (traces_onyx_doc_ring_hraw.yield.json live_eval_session_ids). PRIVATE onyx data -- never upload unsanitized to HF.
